newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana's April yr-on-yr inflation 29.1 percent.
newsitem.headline: Ghana's April yr-on-yr inflation 29.1 percent.

text.p: Ghana's government statistical service said consumer price inflation dipped to a year-on-year 29.1 percent in April from 29.2 percent in March.

Note -- Inflation in Ghana has been falling for the past 16 months but the decline is slowing. While in the first half of 1996 year-on-year inflation went down by four to six percentage points a month, the decline has been only about one point or less per month since last October.
Prices in April showed an average increase of 3.4 percent from March, compared to 2.8 percent in March.
The government's objective is to reduce year-on-year inflation to 15 percent by December 31, 1997.
